snippet.title: Donkey Kong Country 3 GBA / Super Donkey Kong 3 GBA Japanese Commercial
snippet.description:
Usually, it's the lions doing the sneak attack... Swing on over to this packaging translation of DKC3 for the GBA: https://chrisaaronblog.blogspot.com/2024/06/donkey-kong-country-3-super-donkey-kong.html Check out my original videos (Game reviews, book reviews, and more) at https://www.youtube.com/@83chrisaaronextra and visit http://www.chrislovesjapan.com for even more Japanese related content. 

My transcription of the audio:
ドンキーが一大事！
沢山の仲間と、ドンキーを探す大冒険！
ゲームボーイアドバンス
スーパードンキーコング３
